correlated_feature_policy.group_alignment: Same frozen TRAIN group identities required for across-family grouped comparisons
correlated_feature_policy.missing: Use exact model preprocessing; report missing pair support; never fit a SHAP-specific imputer
correlated_feature_policy.population: Frozen valid TRAIN reference, at most 256 rows; no T1 correlation computation
correlated_feature_policy.ranks: Average ranks for ties; pairwise finite values only with support count >=3; undefined/constant pairs create no edge
correlated_feature_policy.redistribution: Also report sum_j mean_i(abs(phi_ij)), each member share and cancellation gap
correlated_feature_policy.warning: Small within-group rank swaps need not imply substantive instability; no causal interpretation

e1_e2_bridge_policy.E2_supply: Analytical modality contributions on frozen fusion meta-logit and OOF reference
e1_e2_bridge_policy.allowed_wording: modality-level contribution co-occurred with stable feature-level attribution patterns
e1_e2_bridge_policy.common_chain_required: Exact linked row/population, base state, representation and unimodal probability to E2 inputs for empirical co-occurrence; architecture-only otherwise
forbidden_wording: feature X caused modality Y to dominate
feature X explains the performance gain

statuses.BRIDGE_CONSISTENT: All strong E2 modalities contain STABLE E1 patterns
statuses.BRIDGE_DIVERGENT: Every strong modality has UNSTABLE E1 despite complete eligible comparable evidence
statuses.BRIDGE_INSUFFICIENT_E1: Missing eligible E1, undefined stability, inadequate population or unproved exact common chain
statuses.BRIDGE_PARTIALLY_CONSISTENT: At least one strong modality has STABLE or MIXED_STABILITY E1 but not all are STABLE

e1_e2_bridge_policy.strong_modality: Modality with maximum mean absolute E2 contribution in configuration; exact ties all retained
e1_e2_bridge_policy.unit: project x family x multimodal configuration; only included modalities

e1_e2_continuity_contract.label_assignment: Architectural label is design-level; directional/project/model labels require future evidence and may accompany it; no empirical label assigned now

labels.CONTINUITY_ARCHITECTURAL: Same CODE/PROCESS/TEXT definitions and late-fusion hierarchy documented; distinct reconstructed/historical states and populations disclosed
labels.CONTINUITY_DIRECTIONAL: Architectural continuity plus exact same-row/state/probability linkage, passing E1/E2 fidelity and stable within-scale directional co-occurrence; descriptive only
labels.CONTINUITY_MODEL_DEPENDENT: Directional conditions vary by family within an aligned project/population; all families shown
labels.CONTINUITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Architecture/semantics incompatible or required empirical linkage absent for the proposed claim
labels.CONTINUITY_PROJECT_SPECIFIC: Directional conditions hold only in named projects; disclose all other projects and failures

class_definitions.ARCHITECTURAL: Same frozen modality semantics and late-fusion architecture; distinct study rows/models labelled explicitly
class_definitions.CONCEPTUAL_ONLY: Same modality/family concepts without an exact or validated architectural empirical chain
class_definitions.DIRECT: Same exact local chain and quantities, complete proof
class_definitions.NESTED: Global only, proved nested population with common linked states, adequate coverage and no subset bias
class_definitions.NONE: Material mismatch or missing even conceptual linkage

parent_exact_link_contract.composite_figure: Show linked E1 and E2 panels with explicit scales and baseline definitions; arrows denote provenance, not equality of additive feature bars to fusion-logit bars. No toy numeric examples are results.

cross_level_scale_bridge.boosted_trees: Objective-governed raw margin -> exact positive-class link -> beta_m*(p_m-mu_m)
cross_level_scale_bridge.warning: E1 logit/margin feature attributions cannot be multiplied by beta or summed as the E2 modality attribution without a separately justified compositional method. Nonlinear probability links change the quantity. E1 intercept/feature baseline and E2 OOF baseline differ.

global_requirements: stable direction supported by actual future evidence
parent_exact_link_contract.historical_global_dominance_chain: NOT_SUPPORTED;80 TRAIN rows cannot explain global T1 modality rankings
parent_exact_link_contract.same_predictor_rule: Local DIRECT requires the exact predictor identity, never merely a scientifically linked replacement. Global nested claims require separately proved nesting and state/output linkage.
parent_exact_link_contract.unsupported_local_action: Separate population-level E2 and labelled complementary E1 illustration; no shared-commit title or merged waterfall

prohibited: largest E1 feature necessarily responsible for largest E2 modality contribution
splice prospective E1 and historical E2 into an exact shared-row chain

statuses.FIDELITY_MIXED: Attempted rows pass but expected rows missing; diagnostic only, scope inadmissible
statuses.FIDELITY_PASS: Every expected row attempted and passes finite residual bounds

heterogeneity_contract.TEXT: Project-specific unless exact cross-project semantic mapping is proved
heterogeneity_contract.comparison: Every unordered eligible family pair on common exact feature semantics and aligned population; unequal populations descriptive only, not isolated model effects
heterogeneity_contract.inferential_policy: Descriptive only; no predictive significance tests for explanation superiority; future inferential test requires separate freeze
heterogeneity_contract.material_reversal: Opposite nonzero signed-mean attribution for an aligned top-3 feature, exceeding the fixed zero band in both projects; disclose every reversal
heterogeneity_contract.precedence: Insufficient first; report axis-specific labels, never force one pooled label
heterogeneity_contract.scales: Compare ranks and normalized nonnegative mean-absolute attribution distributions only; never pool raw probability/logit/margin magnitudes
heterogeneity_contract.sign_comparison: Aligned signed-mean feature contribution direction only; differing references disclosed; cancellation/undefined signs reported

statuses.HETEROGENEOUS_PATTERN: Both axes disagree or no single project/family localization supported
statuses.INSUFFICIENT_CROSS_MODEL_EVIDENCE: Fewer than 3 comparable eligible families or required comparison metrics undefined
statuses.MODEL_DEPENDENT_PATTERN: Within-project cross-family disagreement with a consistent passing within-family cross-project pattern
statuses.PROJECT_SPECIFIC_PATTERN: Within-project stable pattern but cross-project support rule fails
statuses.STABLE_CROSS_MODEL_PATTERN: All comparable family pairs meet all thresholds within project

heterogeneity_contract.universal: All 14 candidate projects and all four families eligible/comparable and passing, with zero material reversals; otherwise no universal claim

local_case_selection_policy.algorithm: Within each class select ordered roles without replacement, ties by global selection key. Reallocate unused class slots by ascending global key. If probability or threshold linkage incomplete, use ascending global key with available decision quotas; annotate confidence roles unavailable.
local_case_selection_policy.class_quota: Four predicted-positive and four predicted-negative if available
local_case_selection_policy.label_aware_alternative: Future amendment may specify high-confidence TP,TN,FP,FN,near-threshold positive,near-threshold negative,median-confidence,integrity-supported extreme; prohibited in current primary selection
local_case_selection_policy.labels: TP/TN/FP/FN strata not authorized; correctness may be annotated after selection only under separate label access authorization
ordered_roles_per_predicted_class: minimum distance from within-class median absolute p_minus_frozen_threshold
maximum absolute p_minus_frozen_threshold among remaining: integrity-supported extreme
local_case_selection_policy.probability_scale: Exactly frozen decision input scale, calibration identity recorded; no newly computed confidence for selection
local_case_selection_policy.tie_break: SHA-256 lexical ordering over stable row identity; identity lexical order resolves a hash collision

prohibited: reconstructed states are original Sprint54 models
unvalidated end-to-end E1 decomposition of E2
largest E1 feature caused largest E2 modality contribution

parent_architecture.complementary: New prospective paired E1/E2/E3 validation with complete source/input/state persistence
parent_architecture.future_within_prospective_continuity: DIRECT conditional on exact machine-verifiable chain
parent_architecture.limited_historical_E1: ILLUSTRATIVE_ONLY, optional outside selected inferential core and only after separate authorization
parent_architecture.primary: Historical E2 analytical multimodal decomposition across221 eligible scopes; E3 separated
parent_architecture.prospective_to_historical_continuity: ARCHITECTURAL conditional design; not empirical DIRECT

stability_contract.TV: 0.5*sum(abs(p_j-q_j)), p normalized mean absolute attribution over identical support; all-zero distribution undefined
stability_contract.k: min(k, aligned feature count); k covering entire support is non-discriminating and cannot alone support STABLE
stability_contract.populations: Identical state, reference and foreground across seeds; no population reselection
stability_contract.ranking: Descending mean absolute attribution; exact feature identity lexical tie-break; Spearman uses average tied ranks
stability_contract.scope: Numerical repeatability and fixed-population ranking agreement, not sampling/reference robustness
stability_contract.sign_agreement: Fraction of aligned row-feature attribution entries with equal sign using zero band +/-1e-12; also report signed-mean global agreement; do not silently drop zeros

statuses.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Missing repetition, fidelity failure, unaligned support, undefined required metric or no informative metric
statuses.MIXED_STABILITY: Fidelity complete and numerical repeatability passes, with both passing and failing informative ranking diagnostics
statuses.STABLE: Fidelity complete; all numerical repeats <=1e-12 and all defined informative metrics meet all frozen thresholds
statuses.UNSTABLE: Any numerical-repeat bound violation or all informative ranking diagnostics fail

stability_contract.threshold_source: Sprint55 heterogeneity diagnostic thresholds; prospectively applied to comparable ranking diagnostics
stability_contract.undefined: Report reason; never replace undefined with a pass

t1_global_foreground_policy.allocation: If N<=256 take all. Otherwise cyclic lexicographic nonempty-stratum allocation, one row per stratum per cycle until cap; exhausted strata skipped
t1_global_foreground_policy.canonical_JSON: ensure_ascii=false; separators=(comma,colon); no whitespace; identity strings exact, no normalization
t1_global_foreground_policy.confidence_bins: Not used for global sampling; avoids extra output access requirements
t1_global_foreground_policy.decision_source: Previously frozen outputs linked by exact state/row identity; never query entire T1 to select cases
t1_global_foreground_policy.identity_gate: Unique canonical project+commit identity, exact partition proof, valid representation; missing or conflicting identity blocks scope
t1_global_foreground_policy.new_population: Not a substitute for historical T1; requires separate prospective design amendment and own partition namespace
t1_global_foreground_policy.primary_estimand: Mean over balanced selected reference/foreground, not prevalence-weighted full partition mean
t1_global_foreground_policy.representation_identity: Frozen project/modality preprocessing+feature-order digest; shared across families when exact representation compatible; include family only if technically required
t1_global_foreground_policy.representation_validity: Validate before sampling; retain excluded counts/reasons; systematic or ambiguous provenance blocks scope
t1_global_foreground_policy.source_population: Exact project T1 membership already governed in parent G4/G5; eligibility requires legitimate complete representation evidence
t1_global_foreground_policy.strata: Frozen predicted decision 0/1 if complete; otherwise one identity-only stratum
t1_global_foreground_policy.temporal_coverage: Report selected/source ranges after authorized selection; no temporal data invented and no reselection from diagnostics
t1_global_foreground_policy.tie_break: SHA-256 lexical ordering over stable row identity; identity lexical order resolves a hash collision
t1_global_foreground_policy.within_stratum: Ascending stable_key; final selected order ascending stable_key

t1_xai_access_policy.metadata_reads: Scope aggregate counts and digests only; no individual T1 identities, labels, features or prediction rows

text_e1_contract.cross_project: No literal token-rank averaging without demonstrated vocabulary and semantic alignment
text_e1_contract.empty_message: Preserve frozen vectorizer behavior; no synthetic token or silent row deletion
text_e1_contract.global: Mean absolute token attribution within project/model over ALL selected rows, including zero-valued tokens
text_e1_contract.local: Exact transformed message token contributions; retain nonzero attribution to absent tokens for centered/path-dependent methods
text_e1_contract.semantic_categories: Optional only with explicit versioned manual coding rubric, token-to-category map and reproducible coding audit before synthesis

train_background_policy.kmeans_sensitivity: Separate prospective amendment only after documented necessity, primary infeasibility and reduced/unreduced comparison protocol
train_background_policy.label_permission_decision: Record source-level authorization and completeness before selection, never infer from outcomes

train_background_policy.strata: Legitimate frozen TRAIN binary label if complete and authorized, otherwise one unlabelled stratum
